title: NCAA: Zed Etulle’s clutch free throws lift San Beda past JRU

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Zed Etulle towed San Beda out of trouble as the Red Lions held off Jose Rizal University, 75-71, in Group A of the NCAA Season 102 men’s basketball tournament at San Juan Arena on Friday. With the Red Lions’ lead slipping away, Etulle coolly sank all four of his crucial free throws in crunch time to help the squad improve to 7-3. “We always talk about winning plays,” coach Yuri Escueta said. “[Etulle’s] rebounds, his free throws, they were big for us, especially when he knocked down all those four crucial free throws. It’s good for us and Zed’s confidence.” […]... Keep on reading: NCAA: Zed Etulle’s clutch free throws lift San Beda past JRU
